data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to read, filter, search, and stream SMS messages on Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications running on Android to fetch SMS messages from inbox, sent, and draft folders with pagination and search. It also supports checkpoint-based incremental inbox reads and real-time streaming of incoming messages.
use_when: You need to read or search SMS messages within an Android Flutter application.
You want to stream incoming SMS messages in real-time.
You require incremental inbox syncing using checkpoints.
avoid_when: You are targeting iOS or other non-Android platforms.
You cannot qualify for Google Play restricted SMS permissions.
strengths: Supports pagination, filtering, and search by keyword or phone number.
Provides native checkpoint-based incremental inbox reading.
Includes real-time streaming of incoming SMS messages.
weaknesses: Android only; throws MissingPluginException on other platforms.
Requires restricted Google Play permissions (READ_SMS, RECEIVE_SMS).
data.setup_notes: Add READ_SMS and RECEIVE_SMS permissions to AndroidManifest.xml and handle runtime permissions using a package like permission_handler.
